decision_notes: The official site identifies the unicameral legislature under Constitution Part IV. Section 59 of the 2009 Constitution establishes general territorial lawmaking; the financial provisions and current House and Finance Committee records establish budget scrutiny. The institution is now styled Parliament, confirmed by the current official site; the original constitutional text uses Legislative Assembly. Evidence: https://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2009/1379/pdfs/uksi_20091379_en.pdf
British Overseas Territory; a separate map parent and UK search association do not classify it as a UK administrative subdivision.

Official parliament.ky homepage links the government Parliament playlist separately from the broader government channel. A 5 October 2026 plenary sitting and 8 October Finance Committee recording both passed advancing-playback and 854x480 decoded-frame checks. These are recordings; current on-air live coverage was not established.
Added with flag, localized territorial name, UK search association, map outline and planned calendar link.
